findings.title: Public findMany() removed without updating callers
findings.body: insightsBooking.ts replaces the public findMany(findManyArgs) method that applied authorization and filter conditions via Prisma findMany with getBaseConditions() returning Prisma.Sql. The diff shows no other files updated and no compatibility shim. Any existing caller importing InsightsBookingService and calling findMany will fail to compile or throw at runtime, breaking the insights booking API contract.

findings.title: OR fragments returned without outer parentheses enable precedence bypass
findings.body: buildOrgAuthorizationCondition, buildTeamAuthorizationCondition, and buildFilterConditions return fragments like A AND B OR C AND D and A OR B with no surrounding parentheses. The class exposes them publicly via getAuthorizationConditions/getFilterConditions. If any consumer composes them as WHERE ${auth} AND <extra> then SQL precedence (AND binds tighter than OR) evaluates as A OR (C AND <extra>), so rows matching the first disjunct bypass the extra predicate. getBaseConditions wraps them today, but the public fragments are unsafe to compose. Wrap OR-joined fragments in parentheses at construction.

findings.title: Caching coverage deleted
findings.body: The test file deletes the entire Caching describe block that verified getAuthorizationConditions and getFilterConditions are cached. The service in insightsBooking.ts still implements cachedAuthConditions/cachedFilterConditions. Removing the tests leaves stale-cache or mutation bugs undetected with no replacement coverage.
